main_text.p: gaudia mutuò inter se comparentur. Nam il-Piorumli in Deo, hi vero in rebus terrenis gaudent: gaudiaillorū animus vera & solida laetitia perfundi-cum imtur, horum caro laetitia exterius tantum aspĕrproborūgitur. Illi in mediis doloribus exultant, hi in gaudiismediis gaudiis dolent atq; cruciantur. Illorū coparanperpetua, horū fluxa & caduca est laetitia. De-tur.niq; illorū gaudia semper augetur, donec tan-dem illis æterna fœlicitas tanquā cumulus ac-cedat: horū vero spes in desperatione, vita in morte æternā, gaudia momentanea in perpe-tuos dolores cōuertūtur. Facessat igitur vanę mundi carnisq; bladitiæ: neq; nobis improbo-rū gaudia fucu faciant. Sed audiamus potius Dauide affirmante eorū demū esse laetari qui in Domino laetatur, qui iustitię & pietati stu-det & quorū animus integer est & vacuus o-mni hypocrisi atq; simulatione. Itaq;, fratres, interiore animi integritate colamus & recta sanaq; cōscientia retineamus, quę veri gaudij sedes est atq; domicilium. Nec eos imitemur qui hoc tēpore Euangelio renunciarūt & mūdi insana gaudia cruci Christi prætulerūt. Qui, si verū fateantur, dicet se intus in animo cru-ciari infinitis doloribus. Danda igitur est o-pera vt cor nostrum sit rectum, vt Dauid lo-quitur, atque ita verę ac spiritualis lætitiæ par-ticipes esse possimus. Cùm autem Propheta Ier .17.doceat, cor hominis natura peruersum esse, petamus à Deo vt peruersitate nobis insitam à natura, corrigat suo Spiritu, vt ita illius gra

page.notes: Marginal notes transcribed as printed; "cum im" is the note beside line 3 and may be cut off at the margin (possibly "cum im-" with a continuation) and is marked as such. The note "tur." beside "De-" is a separate marginal note. The last word "gra" is a fragment at the page foot and is left as printed. The text at the very top of the page is a continuation, so the first paragraph carries cont="true". Lower-left "9" is a stray mark, not printed text, and is excluded. Some letters in the margin notes are faint; "coparan" and "proborū" read as printed but should be checked against the original.
